svg.aria-label: Build pipeline: the Arm toolchains, OP-TEE, U-Boot, TF-A, the Linux kernel and a Debian or Alpine rootfs are built by firmware, kernel and rootfs steps into tee, u-boot, BL2, fip.bin, kernel and rootfs artifacts, which the image step assembles into a GPT sdcard.img with fakeroot, mke2fs, sfdisk and dd.
svg.text: What ./build.sh all does: sources in, one SD card image out
Four source trees go in, built with two pinned Arm compilers. Everything lands in build/deploy/; scripts/image.sh stitches it together without root.
host tool that writes the FIP
fiptool packs OP-TEE (3 files), U-Boot, DTBs
Dry run: ./build.sh --dry-run all | less -R prints every command with the reason it exists. Each step also runs alone, e.g. ./build.sh firmware fip re-packs only the FIP.

Arm GNU Toolchain 14.3 (sha256-pinned): arm-none-eabi for TF-A and the OP-TEE core (no OS), arm-none-linux-gnueabihf for the kernel and U-Boot. Source trees are checked out once into build/src/ and left alone.
